title: Removal of a Trim Air Zone Valve from the Ceiling Distribution Run

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of a trim air zone valve from the ceiling distribution run, used before a valve exchange, before a seat or sensor modification, or to get access to the duct outlet flange for inspection.

sections.purpose: This task removes one trim air zone valve from the ceiling distribution run, on either the forward or the aft station, so that the valve can be exchanged or the duct outlet flange can be inspected.
sections.job_setup_note: The air conditioning system must be depressurised and the packs selected off before you start. The duct stays hot for a long time after the packs are shut down, so allow the cooling period given in the instructions and check the duct temperature by hand before you touch the joint. Two persons are needed once the valve is unbolted, because the valve is heavy for its size and the ceiling working position gives no support.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the packs are selected off and that the air conditioning system is depressurised. 2. Put the warning notice in the flight compartment. WARNING: DO NOT TOUCH THE TRIM AIR DUCT UNTIL YOU HAVE MEASURED THE SURFACE TEMPERATURE. THE DUCT STAYS ABOVE 100 DEGREES FOR MORE THAN AN HOUR AFTER SHUTDOWN. 3. Remove the ceiling panels in zone 254 and, for the aft station, in zone 291. 4. Remove the closeout above the distribution run. 5. Disconnect the electrical connector at the valve and fit the protective cap. 6. Where a duct-mounted sensor is installed, disconnect the sensor harness at the boss and put an identification tag on it. 7. Loosen the two duct clamps at the valve and hold the valve while you remove them. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE VALVE HANG ON THE DUCT. THE OUTLET FLANGE IS THIN AND WILL DISTORT. 8. Lower the valve with a second person supporting it and put it on a clean surface. 9. Install the blanking caps in the duct ends. 10. Do a detailed visual inspection of the duct outlet flange face and record any dressing, scoring or corrosion.
sections.close_out: Leave the blanking caps in the duct if the aircraft is to be left overnight. Put the removed valve in its transport container with the connector cap fitted. Make an entry in the technical log that the zone is unregulated and that the aircraft must not be released to service until the valve is installed.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Step 6 applies to aircraft post MOD-153140 only.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the packs are selected off.
Put the warning notice in the flight compartment.
Measure the duct surface temperature before you touch the joint.
